description: Corrected the initialization mapping bug in the `Block` class where `self.resid_lambdas` (the class dictionary attribute) were incorrectly assigned to the forward pass parameters (`self.x` and `self.x0`) instead of the class dictionary attributes (`self.resid_lambdas`), causing the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step (empty tensors) and crash the training loop. By correctly assigning `self.resid_lambdas` to the forward pass parameters, the optimizer now initializes gradients from the first step, restoring stable val_bpb to ~0.9912.
